title: Jubilant Spanish Chestnut Mushroom Pulpo A La Gallega
description: A herbal and aerated Spanish dish featuring chestnut mushroom and dashi extract, inspired by the pulpo a la gallega style, this recipe is perfect for a brunch mood and is buddhist temple friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced chestnut mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the dashi extract, paprika, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes until the mushrooms are coated in the spice mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Transfer the mushroom mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
This dish is best served with crusty bread or over rice.
You can also add some grilled octopus or other seafood to make it more substantial.
